title: 2 BOXES OF PHOTO FRAMES, VANIT...
reason: Silver-coloured embossed frames and a mirror on blue velvet could be sterling, but no hallmark is visible and silver is not claimed, so this is speculative: check backs and edges for hallmarks at the viewing.
findings: One photo of about 11 items: three silver-coloured embossed photo frames (a large one with a scrolled floral border at the back right, a medium one with a pebbled floral border on a dark back, and a shell-cornered one with a maroon insert card printed 'Grosvenor' with a small G crest), a scalloped embossed mirror on blue velvet, two embossed silver-coloured hand mirrors, a comb with a metal back, a small gilt textured frame, a heart-shaped brass-coloured frame, a Solid Brass tri-fold photo frame (logo 'Solid Brass photo frames') and a wooden jewellery box with a carved lid and red lining. The silver-coloured pieces are thin embossed sheet on wood or velvet, a construction used for both sterling and plated frames. None shows a legible hallmark, 925 stamp or maker's mark in the photo (backs and lower edges not visible), so silver content is unverified, and the catalogue does not claim silver.
condition: Surfaces look clean with light tarnish on the hand mirrors. Backs, glass, stands and velvet condition are not visible, so damage cannot be judged.
rescore_note: Embossed silver-coloured frames, velvet-backed mirror and hand mirrors look like plate or thin sterling over wood, plus brass frames and a jewellery box; no hallmark visible and silver not claimed, so scored as mostly plated with a small sterling upside. Judged $30 to $80 band. Not price-checked (search limit hit).
